# 4-Day Budget Lisbon Getaway, 10–13 Apr 2026

A relaxed Lisbon plan for 2 adults, built around walking, museums, local food, and one scenic day trip. I’ve kept the pace to no more than 2 major activities per day and aimed to stay within **€1,200 total** excluding flights.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1 — Historic Center + Riverside First Look
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and take an easy walk through Baixa and Rossio; stop for coffee and a pastel de nata.
- **Afternoon:** Explore Chiado and the Carmo area; if energy is good, ride the Santa Justa area on foot rather than paying for the lift.
- **Food:** Simple lunch at a tasca: bifana, soup, or grilled fish; dinner in Bairro Alto or Príncipe Real.
- **Transit tips:** Use walking for the center; if needed, use the metro or a short Bolt ride instead of taxis.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€140–€190**
  - Accommodation share: €90–€130
  - Meals + coffee: €35–€50
  - Local transit: €5–€10
  - Small entry/snacks: €10–€20

### Day 2 — Alfama, Lisbon Museum, and Sunset Views
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Walk Alfama at a slow pace, including Sé area and Miradouro de Santa Luzia.
- **Afternoon:** Choose one museum: Museu do Fado or Museu Nacional do Azulejo, depending on your interest.
- **Food:** Lunch in Alfama with grilled sardines, cod, or petiscos; dinner near Graça for better value than the main tourist strips.
- **Transit tips:** Alfama is best on foot; use tram or bus only for uphill sections if needed.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€150–€210**
  - Accommodation share: €90–€130
  - Museum tickets: €20–€30
  - Meals + drinks: €35–€50
  - Transit: €5–€10

### Day 3 — Scenic Day Trip to Sintra
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Take the train to Sintra early and visit **one** main site: Pena Palace or Quinta da Regaleira.
- **Afternoon:** Keep it light with the historic center and one viewpoint, then return to Lisbon before evening rush.
- **Food:** Picnic-style lunch or a simple café meal in Sintra; dinner back in Lisbon, ideally near your hotel.
- **Transit tips:** Train is the cheapest and easiest option; use the local bus only if your chosen site is far uphill.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€190–€280**
  - Accommodation share: €90–€130
  - Train + local transit: €20–€35
  - Tickets: €30–€50
  - Meals + snacks: €50–€65

### Day 4 — Belém Highlights + Slow Farewell
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Head to Belém for Jerónimos area and the riverside walk.
- **Afternoon:** Pick one major stop: MAAT, Museu Nacional dos Coches, or a relaxed waterfront café session.
- **Food:** Have the classic pastel de nata stop in Belém and a final seafood lunch.
- **Transit tips:** Tram or bus works well here; avoid mixing too many stops so the day stays relaxed.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€140–€200**
  - Accommodation share: €90–€130
  - Meals + pastries: €35–€50
  - Transit: €5–€10
  - Entry fees: €10–€20

## Budget Plan and Best Value Choices

| Category | Planned Range | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Accommodation | €360–€520 | 3 nights, mid-budget guesthouse or 3-star hotel |
| Food + drinks | €160–€215 | Mix of cafés, tascas, and one nicer dinner |
| Transit | €20–€35 | Mostly walking, metro, tram, and one train day trip |
| Museums + entries | €70–€120 | 2–3 paid attractions plus Sintra ticket(s) |
| Snacks/coffee/contingency | €40–€70 | Small buffer for extras |
| **Total** | **€650–€960** | Leaves room for comfort upgrades |

## Rainy-Day Backup Plan

### If rain affects your outdoor plans
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg
- Swap Alfama wandering for **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** or **Museu do Fado**.
- Replace Belém walking with **MAAT** or **Museu Nacional dos Coches**.
- Use cafés in Chiado or Príncipe Real for a slow lunch break and planning time.
- If Sintra is too wet, keep the day in Lisbon and do a museum + long lunch + covered shopping streets instead.

### Best indoor pairings by area
- **Baixa/Chiado:** cafés, bookstores, galleries, covered shopping streets
- **Alfama:** Fado museum, tile museum, long lunch
- **Belém:** MAAT, Coaches Museum, pastel de nata stop
- **Sintra fallback:** stay in Lisbon and choose one museum plus a scenic tram or riverside ride if weather clears

- Lisbon public transit: https://www.metrolisboa.pt/en/

- Museums and monuments: https://www.museusemonumentos.pt/en/
- Lisbon tourism: https://www.visitlisboa.com/
